messages:
Emma: Hey team — putting together a single-page runbook we can hand to customers who see intermittent streaming dropouts + sudden token spikes. Need a lightweight checklist and a short SDK example we can paste in emails.
Raj: +1. Make it customer-facing: minimal jargon, clear 'what to check' steps, and a few safe config knobs to try.
Miguel: Draft checklist idea: 1) Confirm client uses latest SDK (streams fixed in v1.4.2) 2) Check network stability & MTU (esp mobile) 3) Verify max_tokens and streaming window settings 4) Enable token-surge guard on server side.
Olivia: Also add an "if this happens during onboarding" section: quick rollback to non-stream mode, send a trimmed prompt, and open a support ticket with logs.
Emma: Good. Can we include a tiny code snippet for progressive-batching + streaming timeout? Keep it simple.
Miguel: Example (JS):
```
// progressive-batch + stream guard
const s = client.stream({
  model: 'redwood-mini',
  stream: true,
  batch_window_ms: 30, // small window for low-latency bursts
  max_concurrent_sessions: 4,
  token_surge_guard: { threshold: 2000, action: 'throttle' }
});
```
Olivia: Add a non-stream fallback example: set stream=false and drop max_tokens to 150 for retries.
Raj: For the one-pager, include quick telemetry checks customers can run: average tokens/session, 95th pct latency, stream disconnect rate per 10k requests. Show thresholds we consider 'healthy' (tokens/session < 800, 95p latency < 600ms, disconnects < 0.5%).
Emma: Nice. Also include a short troubleshooting flow: "stream drops -> check client SDK version -> capture client logs -> switch to non-stream fallback -> collect sample request ids -> escalate if >3 incidents in 24h."
CS Bot: Template generated: https://internal.redwood/doc-templates/cs/streaming-one-pager (auto-draft). Use this to create customer email. :robot_face:
Miguel: Renewal risk note: flag customers with >2 onboarding stream incidents and declining engagement; propose a short enablement call and prioritize warm-pool prefill for them.
Olivia: Tone: "We can help" — include step-by-step actions they can take immediately + offer a 30-min troubleshooting session.
Emma: I'll assemble the one-pager and paste into the shared drive. Can someone review before I send to Acme pilot?
Raj: I'll do a quick pass. Add line about collecting sample responses (so we can run quality regression checks).
Miguel: I'll add the SDK snippets for Python + curl.
Emma: Thanks — aiming to ship a draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
Olivia: If anyone captures a live incident, drop logs here and tag me.
CS Bot: Reminder scheduled: send draft review ping at 17:00 PST.
